description.en: Removes a character from the player's party/roster by base parameter ID, with options to reset their stats and to lock the party slot.
Base character parameter ID to remove.
Whether to reset the character's stats on removal.
Whether to lock the party slot after removal.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Remove a character from the party
CMND_REMOVE_PARTY(_paramID, _flg_st_reset, _flg_pt_lock);
